value.answer: It depends on the lender and on whether your down payment is under 20% (insured). From what I can find, the lowest insured 5-year fixed is 4.34%. The lowest uninsured one I found is 4.44%, but the sources disagree on that, so treat it as unconfirmed. Big banks are higher: around 4.54%, and Scotiabank is at 4.74%. Fixed rates have been climbing since early September. I couldn't find a Toronto-specific figure.
